ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Velociraptor Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the suspicious use of the Velociraptor DFIR tool to execute other tools or download additional payloads, as seen in a campaign where it was abused for remote access and to stage further attacks.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Velociraptor\\\.exe$") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*code\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*tunnel.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-accept\\-server\\-license\\-terms.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*msiexec.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/i.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*IWR\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadFile.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DownloadString.*"))))
